# Where Claude Code Fits

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## Where Claude Code Fits

Claude Code is an AI coding agent that runs in your terminal. It reads your codebase, understands context, and executes multi-file changes based on your instructions. Unlike a chat interface where you copy-paste code, Claude Code works directly inside your project.

In the SpeedBlip build, Claude Code handled all code execution. Every chunk prompt I wrote was fed into Claude Code, which then created files, wrote components, configured TypeScript, set up hooks, and wired everything together. I reviewed the output, tested it, committed it, and moved to the next chunk.

The important thing to understand is that Claude Code is a tool in the workflow - not the workflow itself. The methodology I just walked you through is what makes Claude Code powerful. Without structure, even the best AI coding agent produces chaos.
